Missed-rewrite /r/:slug in the SPA.question: What should /r/:slug feel like for a scan?
Missed-rewrite /r/:slug in the SPA.answer: The slug is the only correct hop. URL/WhatsApp/social: HTTP 307 (or a minimal loading flash) then the final destination — no mini-site, countdown, or CTA on the slug. Pix/vCard/404/virgin/paused still need short HTML because there is no website to 307 to. Remove the SPA localStorage public landing (SCAN-02).
options_presented: Delete SPA branch and rely on server.ts / vercel.json

Unsafe destination on a live slug.question: What happens at scan time if the live destination uses a bad scheme?
Unsafe destination on a live slug.answer: Serve a short safe-error HTML page. Do not 307. Do not pretend paused or 404.
options_presented: Same paused page as existing paused plates

Unsafe destination on a live slug.question: Also reject on save this phase, or scan-time only?
Unsafe destination on a live slug.answer: Both: public scan serves safe-error HTML; destination PUT/POST returns 400 for disallowed schemes. Operator destination forms (DEST-*) stay Phase 4 — this is the scheme filter only.

Unsafe destination on a live slug.question: What counts as official WhatsApp?
Unsafe destination on a live slug.answer: Only https://wa.me/ . api.whatsapp.com and web.whatsapp.com are invalid. Save may normalize digits to https://wa.me/{digits}.

Unsafe destination on a live slug.question: URL pasted without a scheme?
Unsafe destination on a live slug.answer: Prefix https:// and proceed. javascript:/data: still blocked because they have a scheme.

Public landing look (Pix / vCard / 404).question: How to style public HTML pages?
Public landing look (Pix / vCard / 404).answer: Keep the existing pattern: Tailwind utility classes in Fastify HTML strings plus cdn.tailwindcss.com. Do not invent a parallel inline-CSS design system. Do not wire the Vite-compiled SPA CSS into /r/:slug this phase.

Public landing look (Pix / vCard / 404).answer: Yes. Same handler as /r/:slug. SCAN-01 means physical plates use /r/:slug, not that the second endpoint must die.
